title: Water management and conservation merit assessment criteria
text: M1.4.1 Flooding risk is reduced to limit the impact of major rainfall events. M1.4.2 Stormwater is managed on site wherever possible either by containment or infiltration, as permitted by the soil and other site conditions, or otherwise appropriately treated to reduce the export of nutrients, sediments and other pollutants, prior to off site discharge. M1.4.3 Development incorporates water sensitive urban design mechanisms, including water conservation approaches and site appropriate stormwater collection, retention, treatment and reuse.
notes: from: ch3 M1.3. Text identical; renumbered 1.3 -> 1.4.
